spec.prompt: Extremely wide shot: the Voskhod-2 spacecraft (first reference) small in the upper part of frame with a tiny cosmonaut in a white suit floating on a long tether beside it, above the enormous curve of the Earth. The sun sits exactly on the horizon: a thin layered arc of atmosphere glowing crimson, orange, gold, white and deep blue stretches along the whole limb. Clouds catch the first light. Very slow drift. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
